userMessage:

Fetch this URL: https://broadstrokeinc.com/carbonless-forms/assets/index-BLtRmNk1.js

1. **Hero section**: headline (main, highlightTerm, alt), subhead, CTAs, background image, logo
2. **Benefits section**: title, description, all benefit items (icon, title, description, detail), any CTAs, any logo
3. **HowItWorks section**: title, description, all steps
4. **Comparison section**: title, description, columns, all rows (icon, feature, ourSolution, traditionalApproach)
5. **Difference section**: title, description, all differences (icon, title, description), any CTAs
6. **Services/Products section**: title, description, all items (icon, title, description, image), any CTAs
7. **FAQ section**: title, description, all Q&A pairs
8. **Footer CTA**: headline, description, buttonText, href, secondaryButton, taglines
9. **Navigation**: links, serviceLinks, companyLinks, cta
10. **SEO**: title, description, keywords, ogTitle, ogDescription, twitterTitle, twitterDescription
11. **Branding**: tagline

Return in a structured format so I can compare with the local config.json.

IMPORTANT: Use webfetch to get the JS file, then search for the content strings within it.
